title: Surface Engineering Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Specialist recruitment for UK surface engineering and metal finishing. Permanent, contract and interim roles from process engineer to managing director.
h1: Recruitment for the businesses that finish metal.
notes: Home takes the unmodified category head term because it is the only page addressing both audiences, and it accumulates the brand and internal-link equity. The '+ agency' modifier is left as a secondary here and given to /clients as its primary, so the two pages never chase the same SERP. Head term is contested by Hays and the Agency Central directory, so this is a long-term target — the page earns its keep on brand and navigational queries meanwhile.

title: Metal Finishing Recruitment Agency — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Hiring plant managers, process engineers or quality leads for a plating, coating or heat treatment operation? Send a brief; we reply within 24 hours.
h1: Command of the sector. Not adjacent to it.
notes: The 'agency' modifier is employer-leaning, which matches this page's hiring intent and keeps it clear of home's unmodified head term. No incumbent owns 'metal finishing recruitment agency' — the SERP splits between job boards, generalist agencies and finishers' own careers pages. The NADCAP/AS9100 secondaries live here rather than on a separate page: the research found zero recruitment competition on those terms, so a well-built section converts without needing its own URL and without fragmenting authority.

title: Surface Engineering Jobs and Careers — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Roles across electroplating, anodising, powder coating, heat treatment and thermal spray. Confidential, and your CV goes nowhere without your say-so.
h1: Your next role in surface engineering.
notes: Deliberate split from /jobs to avoid cannibalisation: 'surface engineering jobs' is broad career-exploration intent — Indeed's 1,597 matches include OEM, R&D and academic roles — so it is best served by a page that explains the sector, the role families and how to register. /jobs takes the concrete vacancy-hunting term instead. This page must link prominently to /jobs so the two read as a funnel, not as rivals.

title: Live Metal Finishing Jobs — Surface Talent

Add that markup with the live feed, not before: marking up the current empty state would be worse than nothing.

title: Surface Finishing Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Fourteen finishing disciplines recruited individually — electroplating, anodising, galvanising, thermal spray, PVD, electroless nickel and more.
h1: The full breadth of surface engineering. Known individually, not generically.
notes: Given the term Google currently mis-serves: the SERP for 'surface finishing recruitment' returns plasterers and office-support agencies, so a correctly-scoped industrial page has an unusually clean run. Cheap to take, but low and ambiguous volume — do not expect traffic. This page is also the parent hub for the discipline children and the home for the disciplines with too little demand to justify their own URL (galvanising, PVD/CVD, electroless, PCB finishing, weld overlay, plating on plastics, polishing, blasting). Children must expand its copy, never restate it.

title: Electroplating Jobs and Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Zinc, nickel, hard chrome, precious metals — rack and barrel. We recruit platers, process chemists, line supervisors and plating managers UK-wide.
h1: Electroplating recruitment, from the line to the boardroom.
notes: Create. Genuine distinct intent and Surface Talent's core discipline: 23 live UK roles on LinkedIn, 9 on Glassdoor, and the IMF's own four-item noticeboard is majority plating roles. No agency page ranks at all — the SERP is job boards, employer careers pages and a Talent.com salary page. Real bands (£34–38k at Hayes) sit well above the £27,750 blended average those salary pages report, which is the wedge. Owns the process term so /jobs can keep the generic one.

title: Anodising Jobs and Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Sulphuric, chromic, hard and architectural anodising. We recruit line technicians, quality leads and plant managers for UK anodisers and finishers.
h1: Anodising recruitment across aluminium and multi-metal.
notes: Create. Distinct intent with a distinct employer set (architectural anodisers, aerospace finishers, specialist hard anodisers) and a shallow SERP — only 4 live Totaljobs roles, with employer vacancy pages and DWP Find a Job placing organically, which signals the SERP is weak enough to enter. Use UK 'anodising' in title, H1 and URL; cover the -z- variant in body copy only, since 'anodizing' results skew to non-UK boards.

title: Powder Coating Jobs and Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Architectural and industrial powder coating to Qualicoat and BS EN standards. We recruit supervisors, quality leads, production and plant managers.
h1: Powder coating and industrial coatings recruitment.
notes: Create, but scope it narrowly. Highest observed demand of any discipline (CV-Library 189 roles from 103 employers, Adzuna 115, Reed 91) — and the most hostile: Agency Central lists 60+ industrial agencies already supplying powder coaters, including Adecco and Manpower, at £12.21–£14.00/hour. Do not compete for operative volume. Target supervisory and technical grades and the Qualicoat/BS EN standards long-tail, where the volume agencies have nothing to say. Head-term ranking is not realistic near-term.

title: Heat Treatment Jobs and Recruitment — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Carburising, nitriding, vacuum, atmosphere and induction. We recruit metallurgists, furnace managers, process engineers and quality professionals.
h1: Heat treatment recruitment, commercial and captive.
notes: Create. Strongest listing volume in the set (Glassdoor 212, LinkedIn 151, ZipRecruiter 110, Totaljobs 74) and a genuinely separate sub-sector — the CHTA and Wolfson Heat Treatment Centre have their own standing inside the SEA. Two constraints to plan around: the bare head term is not winnable against those job-board counts, and 'heat treatment recruitment' collides with Heat Recruitment Ltd (financial services) and with HVAC heating-engineer agencies. Win on metallurgical long-tail and disambiguate with process vocabulary in the first paragraph.

title: Thermal Spray and HVOF Jobs — Surface Talent
metaDescription: HVOF, plasma, arc and flame spray for aerospace, gas turbine and energy. We recruit coating engineers, operators and commercial leads across the UK.
h1: Thermal spray recruitment for aerospace, energy and gas turbine.
notes: Create, but on value rather than volume, and treat as lower priority than the four above. Intent is unambiguous and distinct (HVOF/plasma means nothing else) but demand is tiny — 7 live UK roles each on LinkedIn and Glassdoor, with US results bleeding in because supply is so thin. The justification is that no thermal spray recruitment landing page exists anywhere in the UK index: VHR ranks on a single job posting for a £50–60k manager role. Expect a handful of visits; one placement at that grade repays the page many times over. Do not report this page on traffic.

title: Pre-treatment and Surface Preparation — Surface Talent
metaDescription: Aqueous and ultrasonic cleaning, vapour degreasing, pickling and chemical pre-treatment — the lines that sit in front of every plating operation.
notes: Skip — three reasons, all evidenced. (1) 'Pre-treatment jobs' is not a jobseeker query: the search returned shot blasting results instead, and no UK job board maintains a pre-treatment listing page, so there is no intent to serve. The term is B2B process jargon used by buyers, not candidates. (2) The adjacent term that does have demand is different — shot blasting (Glassdoor 95, CV-Library, Jooble) — and building on 'pre-treatment' would target neither. (3) That blasting demand is overwhelmingly low-skill operative and temp work at the bottom of the market, which sits outside Surface Talent's process-engineer-to-MD positioning. Keep both topics as sections on /disciplines, where lanes 10 and 11 already cover them. If a page is ever justified, build /disciplines/shot-blasting-and-peening on real blasting and Almen/shot-peening demand — not 'pre-treatment'.
